name: Spire Sense
author: jerry
description: Overlay showing what your deck is made of and what it is doing. Counts how many cards do each deckbuilding job (frontloaded damage, area damage, block, scaling, card draw), and measures your real damage and mitigation per turn as the run goes. Hover any card to see its jobs; open a card to reclassify it yourself. Press Insert to hide the panel.
